perspective: Combined producer and adopter incremental resource cost; not vendor margin or customer willingness to pay.
range_semantics: Closed plausible-input intervals chosen for illustration, not observed distributions, forecasts or confidence intervals. Expected names a working case, not a statistical expectation. Consumers are active consumer-equivalents over the horizon.
years_definition: Integer years from investment to evaluation, 1-30; setup at time zero, annual flows at year end. Two years in these examples is a speculative planning horizon.

consumers.definition: Independent adopters sharing the implementation; each adds integration and support cost.

tasks_per_consumer_year.definition: Demand, not model calls or retry attempts; constant within a run. Use a shorter horizon or separate runs for demand changes.

eligible_fraction.definition: Share covered by the encoded implementation at equivalent acceptance quality; excluded cases use identical fallback work in both approaches.

labor_usd_hour.definition: Blended fully burdened opportunity cost, used symmetrically for setup, support and human review. BLS is contextual, not an estimate of this team's rate.

encode_setup_hours.definition: Incremental authoring, fixtures, independent validation, release and initial governance for encoded/native software; excludes already-sunk common tooling.

infer_setup_hours.definition: Equivalent baseline setup including prompts, retrieval, evaluations and native tool integration; not assumed free.

integration_extra_hours_consumer.unit: encode minus infer hours / consumer at time zero
integration_extra_hours_consumer.definition: Additional adopter adapter/configuration effort; negative values model cheaper encoded integration.

changes_year.unit: material domain changes in year one
changes_year.definition: Operational proxy for stability: changes that require reassessment, repair or recertification, not source commit count.

change_growth_factor.definition: Changes in year index year equal changes_year times factor^year; 0 stops changes after year one, 1 is constant, above 1 accelerates churn.

maintenance_extra_hours_change.unit: encode minus infer hours / material change
maintenance_extra_hours_change.definition: Differential repair, test and recertification labor across supported profiles; includes baseline prompt/retrieval upkeep and may be negative.

support_extra_hours_consumer_year.unit: encode minus infer hours / consumer / year
support_extra_hours_consumer_year.definition: Differential support, runtime operations, policy exceptions and provenance administration; exclude per-case review already counted below.

llm_usd_task.unit: USD / eligible task in year one
llm_usd_task.definition: All metered model/tool charges per task including retries, cached tokens and failed attempts. Token-budget examples are not measurements or evidence of equal capability at different prices.

price_factor.unit: annual multiplier of task API bill
price_factor.definition: Net change in effective bill, including token demand, routing and price; may improve or worsen. Applied to encoded residual LLM use too.

encode_llm_fraction.definition: Residual model use on covered cases; zero is not required for encoding to pay. Encoded quality is entered separately, not derived from this fraction.

infer_review_minutes.unit: minutes / eligible task in year one
infer_review_minutes.definition: Human checking and ordinary rework in the inference workflow; excludes audit, separately charged validation and escaped-incident handling.

encode_review_minutes.definition: Human checking and ordinary rework with encoding; held constant per run, not presumed zero or necessarily cheaper.

review_factor.definition: Change in infer-side review/rework time; independent of price and error changes. Encoded review changes require separate stress runs.

infer_validation_usd_task.definition: Independent test/validation labor and compute for inference, excluding the review minutes already priced.

encode_validation_usd_task.definition: Independent test/validation labor and compute for encoding; both approaches must meet the same acceptance criteria.

infer_audit_minutes.definition: Actual marginal evidence reconstruction or audit handling for inference; zero if no such work is required.

encode_audit_minutes.definition: Same actual audit task with encoded lineage; more metadata is not an assumed benefit or compliance claim.

infer_escape_probability.unit: probability 0-1 / eligible task in year one
infer_escape_probability.definition: Residual material error after all baseline checks, not raw benchmark failure. Domain-specific value is unmeasured.

encode_escape_probability.unit: probability 0-1 / eligible task in year one
encode_escape_probability.definition: Residual material error after encoded checks; software can be wrong. Exclude incidents budgeted as common-cause loss.

infer_error_factor.definition: Yearly change in inference residual error; resulting probabilities clamp at 1. Improvement is not implied by cheaper tokens.

encode_error_factor.definition: Yearly change in encoded residual error, including improvements or stale assumptions; clamp at 1.

loss_usd_escape.definition: Conditional mean loss for this bounded task class; same severity distribution assumed on both sides. Exclude ordinary rework and common-cause incidents. Tail acceptability is a separate gate.

encode_runtime_usd_task.definition: Incremental deterministic runtime cost after common native execution cancels; not a duplicate of validation or support.

common_loss_extra_usd_year.unit: encode minus infer expected-loss allowance USD / year
common_loss_extra_usd_year.definition: Separate portfolio allowance for correlated faults, compromised rules or outages, at the specified rollout scale. Not multiplied by tasks. Unknown is not zero; entering a range is a stress assumption, not a measured event probability.

discount_rate.definition: Buyer opportunity-cost discount in consistent USD terms; labor and non-model unit costs held flat. Not an observed financing rate.

scenarios.name: conservative
scenarios.description: Sparse reuse, changing knowledge, modest review benefit; conservative about encoding.

scenarios.name: expected
scenarios.description: Working middle case, not a probability-weighted expectation; uncertain review savings and adoption.

scenarios.name: aggressive
scenarios.description: High repeated demand, bounded stable support and substantial review reduction; optimistic about encoding, not a forecast.
